title: Iran is Reviewing ‘Concrete Proposals’ on Nuclear Program, Officials Say
summary: Iran’s willingness to re-engage on the issue suggests that Qatar-led diplomatic efforts to avert full-blown war between the U.S. and Iran have had some success.
